verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a dedicated OpenAPI specification repository (github.com/Adyen/adyen-openapi) covering 'every public API Adyen offers' as the 'single source of truth,' explicitly positioned for machine consumption (client-library generation, Postman collections, and LLM/agent context). This is reinforced by llms.txt, markdown-renderable docs, and a full docs mirror ZIP for AI tooling. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the OpenAPI repo is current and complete, and a direct in-docs discoverable openapi.json endpoint (probe found only 404s for openapi.json-style paths on the docs domain itself).
